summary_ja: 内部格付手法準拠方式によるリスク・ウェイトを、デタッチメント・ポイントとアタッチメント・ポイントのK_{IRB}に対する位置に応じ、千二百五十パーセント、K_{SSFA}に十二・五を乗じた比率、または按分した算式で定める。
summary_en: Under the IRB-based method the risk weight is 1,250% where D is at or below K_{IRB}, 12.5 times K_{SSFA}(K_{IRB}) where A is at or above K_{IRB}, and a blended formula where the tranche straddles K_{IRB}; floor of 15%.
paragraphs: The risk weight of a securitization exposure calculated using the IRB-based method shall be the ratio prescribed in the relevant item below according to the case listed in that item; provided, however, that this does not apply where the credit enhancement mechanism provided by the seniority structure of the securitization exposure does not treat losses relating to default risk and losses relating to dilution risk of the underlying assets of that securitization exposure equally. (i) Where the detachment point (D) (meaning the detachment point (D) calculated under Article 234, paragraph (2); the same applies hereinafter) is equal to or less than K_{IRB} (meaning the required capital ratio of the underlying assets under the internal ratings-based approach (K_{IRB}) calculated under Article 232; the same applies hereinafter): 1,250%. (ii) Where the attachment point (A) (meaning the attachment point (A) calculated under Article 234, paragraph (1); the same applies hereinafter) is equal to or greater than K_{IRB}: the ratio obtained by multiplying the required capital ratio for the portion in excess of K_{IRB} calculated under the provisions of the next Article ({{F:p237i0}}) by 12.5 (or 15% where that ratio is less than 15%). (iii) Where the attachment point (A) is less than K_{IRB} and the detachment point (D) exceeds K_{IRB}: the ratio calculated by the following formula (or 15% where that ratio is less than 15%): {{F:p237i1}} {{F:p237i2}} is the required capital ratio for the portion in excess of K_{IRB} calculated under the provisions of the next Article.
